# Windows CI package scope (#108 F05). One package per line: <path> <mode>.
#   native   compiled for windows/amd64 and windows/arm64 on ubuntu AND tested on a windows runner
#   compile  compiled and vetted for both arches only; the reason it is not native yet follows the #
# This list grows with each Windows feature: move a package from compile to native once it passes natively,
# and add new packages here. It must stay equal to windowsProduct in platformset_test.go.
# Excluded on purpose: cmd/ugh and internal/ugh/* (agent port is part 2 of docs/plans/windows.md),
# cmd/ughbot and internal/ughbot/* (outside the port), cmd/misagui and internal/gui/android (Android JNI),
# internal/wayland and internal/xkb (Wayland, Unix only), internal/webui, internal/mweb, internal/webadmin,
# internal/webdevtui (--web, built with noweb), tests/* (Unix-only conformance suites: syscall.Umask, Mkfifo).
. native
